# Compare winners against losers, not winners against the market

`sales.heu.icp_definition.contrast_not_description` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Compare winners against losers, not winners against the market.
 Attributes shared by everyone you sold to and everyone you lost carry no signal. The instinctive method — list what our best customers have in common — reliably produces the least discriminating profile available, because common attributes are common.
